theme.description: Hybrid application. Light mode emphasizes corporate trust and physical paper/reports. Dark mode is sleek for prolonged dashboard usage, emphasizing energy saving.

headings.usage: All H1-H6 tags, widget titles, and hero text. Never use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Paragraphs, labels, table data, and general UI text.

marketing.nav: Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-black/60) with 1px bottom border.
marketing.hero: Asymmetrical layout. Large bold 'Work Sans' typography with nature/industrial imagery blending via soft masking, not heavy black overlays.

dashboard.strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B) + Collapsible Sidebar
dashboard.cards: Flat solid surfaces with sharp edges or subtle 4px radius. 1px solid border. Avoid heavy drop shadows. Cardless where possible for data tables.
dashboard.f_pattern: Place 'Carbon Intensity (kgCO2e/kWh)' as the North Star metric in top-left.

surfaces.headers: Glassmorphism with backdrop-saturate-150 and delicate 1px inner stroke.
surfaces.dashboard_widgets: Neumorphism mix: flat background matching parent, 1px subtle border, sharp inner contrasts.
surfaces.grid_borders: Use border-collapse style layouts for master data tables.

icons.style: Duotone for marketing, Regular/Bold for dashboard clarity.

components.forms: Shadcn UI (Input, Select, Checkbox) heavily customized with sharp borders. Always use Shadcn Form.
components.tables: Shadcn UI Table. Dense padding, hover row highlights.
components.charts: Shadcn UI Charts (Recharts). Use Scope-specific colors (Scope 1: Terracotta, Scope 2: Sky Blue, Scope 3: Moss Green).

motion.marketing: Use framer-motion for scroll-triggered staggered entrances. Smooth scrolling with Lenis.
motion.dashboard: Minimal. Hover states on rows, active states on sidebar links, subtle scale down (0.98) on button click.

images.description: Jakarta skyline. Use for marketing hero or onboarding background.
Solar panels on green field. Use in educational content for Scope 2 (Electricity/Steam).
Logistics cargo truck. Use in educational content for Scope 3 (Value Chain).
Wind turbines in green landscape. Use for public calculator or decarbonization roadmap UI.

media.guidelines: Never use placeholders. Use provided images. Max image height 80vh on mobile.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Work Sans' and 'IBM Plex Sans' in index.html or via CSS @import.
Install required packages: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion recharts sonner`.
Do not center-align the main App container in App.css.
Override tailwind.config.js with the provided colors (Organic & Earthy). Ensure CSS variables map correctly.
Use standard semantic HTML with Tailwind for the marketing landing page (no Shadcn layout components).
Use Shadcn UI extensively for the SaaS dashboard (Tables, Forms, Charts).
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. Do not use fully transparent backgrounds behind text.
Implement the 'Carbon Intensity' North Star metric prominently in the dashboard.
Add transition for hover states on all buttons and cards, excluding transforms from universal transitions.
